notes.title: RELEASE AND 20% DISCOUNT!
notes.notes:
PORTAL OPENED!

So it's time to embark on a fabulous adventure and help our hero Lucius find his missing son. Dozens of fascinating riddles, mystical inhabitants of the Tetragon world, and a surprisingly interesting story await you ahead! 

[previewyoutube=2AEli6L7lPg;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the release of our game, we've launched a 20% discount! Looking forward to your feedback, go ahead, adventurers:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545850/Tetragon/
